description: Reuse RunAgent, Concat and UpdateSheetValues. Definition-time row range (default 2..6) yields distinct step indexes per question, a sequential chain, then matrix construction in row order and one RAW range update. Inputs: start.agent_id, spreadsheet_id, target_range, questions_by_row.row_N; provider/config optional configured opts. Failure before write leaves column unchanged. create transaction uses Workflows public API and event trigger. Tests via temporary harness outside repository only per skill write restriction; existing tests unchanged. No UI/E2E needed; static workflow declarations and thin integration checks.
title: [zaq-54x.1] Generate W2 with isolated question calls and one bulk column update
